notes: PARENT-TOO-YOUNG FLAG RESOLVED (research 2026-07-04): triggered by son Garrett Groff's unsourced '1718' birth year sitting only 3 years after this record's own 1715 birth year. LIKELY DUPLICATE RECORD, NOT A REAL FATHER-SON PAIR (research 2026-07-03): this record (b. 1715, d. 1797) is listed as the PARENT of Garrett Groff (I182381535298, b. 1718) — only a 3-year gap, genealogically implausible as father/son.
